# Introduction

This document details temperature mortality curves for the CCUH/WRI cities using L2 level modifiers. 

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Libraries and plot theming."

# Libraries
library("tidyverse")
library("patchwork")
library("lubridate")
library("glue")
library("dlnm"); library("gnm")

# ggplot2 theming
theme_set(theme_classic())
theme_update(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
             plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
             strip.background = element_blank(),
             strip.text = element_text(size = 12))

# Helper function for getting MMT
get_cen <- function(crosspred) {
  if(!is.null(crosspred$fit)) {
    crosspred$predvar[which.min(crosspred$fit)]
  } else if(!is.null(crosspred$allfit)) {
    crosspred$predvar[which.min(crosspred$allfit)]
  } else {
    print("Unable to locate minimum.")
  }
}

# Helper function for extracting reduced curve
get_df_RRs <- function(pred) {
  tibble(Temperature = pred$predvar,
         RR = pred$RRfit,
         RR_low = pred$RRlow,
         RR_high = pred$RRhigh)
}
```


# Data

The cities we are analyzing include:

- Guatemala City
- Panama City
- Belo Horizonte
- Campinas
- Rio de Janeiro
- Sao Paulo

Our data are traced to the following places:

- The DMC mortality data (`L2_mort_20240320.csv`).
- The DMC temperature data (`TMPDAILY_L1AD_09252023.csv`).
- The BEC L2 data (`BEC_L2_08162023.csv`).
- The SEC L2 census data (`SEC_Census_L2_07062023.csv`).
- The neighborhood level modifier data came from Josiah (`dat_all_2023-08-01.csv`).

These data are aggregated to produce our final data frame, in which each row is a neighborhood (L2) and date (year, month, day). For each row we have the following variables:

- **ISO2**: Country
- **SALID1**: SALURBAL L1 level identifier
- **SALID2**: SALURBAL L2 level identifier
- **YEAR**: Year.
- **MONTH**: Month.
- **DAY**: Day.
- **DEATHS**: Number of deaths for a given L2:year:month:day
- **TMP_PW**: Temperature in Celsius.
- **percent_over_65**: The percentage of a given neighborhood that is over the age of 65. This is static for all date ranges.
- **BECGSPCTL2**: The percentage of land that is green space in a given neighborhood. 
- **CNSMINPR_L2**: The percentage of people that completed primary school (also including those that completed secondary and university degrees).

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| code-summary: "Code to create data frame."

# Mortality data
path1 = "//files.drexel.edu/colleges/SOPH/Shared/UHC/Projects/Wellcome_Trust/Data Methods Core/Data/Mortality Data/temp/P20/"

df_mort <- vroom::vroom(paste0(path1,"Processed_data/L2_mort_20240320.csv")) |> #L1AD_mort_20240320.csv
  mutate(# Put together "Alcalde Diaz","Ernesto Cordoba Campos" and "Las Cumbres"
         # "Alcalde Diaz","Ernesto Cordoba Campos"  originated from "Las Cumbres:
         # assign name and local id of Las Cumbres and aggregate in next step
         L2NAMEOG = L2NAME2,
         L2NAME2 = ifelse(L2NAMEOG %in% c("Alcalde Diaz","Ernesto Cordoba Campos"),"Las Cumbres", L2NAME2),
         SALID2 = as.factor(ifelse(L2NAMEOG %in% c("Alcalde Diaz","Ernesto Cordoba Campos"),"20610140", SALID2)),
         SALID2 = str_sub(SALID2, 1, 8), 
         SALID1 = as.factor(SALID1),
         SALID = SALID2,
         TYPE  = "L2"
  ) |>  
  summarize(DEATHS = sum(as.numeric(DEATHS)), 
            .by = c(ISO2, SALID1, SALID2, L1NAME, L2NAME2, SALID, TYPE, YEAR, MONTH, DAY))

# Population data: PRJL1ADPOP
# Population data exists at the L2 level in the Populations Projections Data 
# folder of the DMC
# files_pop <- paste0(path1, "Processed_data/") |> 
#   list.files(full.names = TRUE) |> 
#   str_subset("PRJ")
# 
# df_pop <- files_pop |> 
#   map(\(x) {
#     vroom::vroom(x) |>
#       mutate(SALID1 = as.factor(SALID1)) |> 
#       summarize(POP = sum(as.numeric(PRJL1ADPOP)),
#                 .by = c(SALID1, YEAR)) 
#   }) |> list_rbind()

# Temperature data
df_temp <- vroom::vroom(paste0(path1,"Processed_data/TMPDAILY_L1AD_09252023.csv")) |> #TMPDAILY_L1AD_20240710.csv
  filter(!(salid1 == 102136 & year < 2007), # Drop Belo Horizonte
         !(salid1 == 102248 & year < 2005)) |> # Drop Sao Paolo (dates with georeferencing issues)
  mutate(salid1 = as.factor(salid1),
         date = ymd(paste(year, month, day, sep = "-")),
         year = year(date), 
         month = month(date),
         day = day(date),
         tmp_pw = tmp_pw, .keep = "none") |> 
  rename_with(toupper)

# Neighborhood level modifier data
# Green space data:             BECGSPCTL2
# Educational attainment data: CNSMINPR_L2
# BEC 
df_BEC_L2 <- vroom::vroom("//files.drexel.edu/colleges/SOPH/Shared/UHC/Projects/Wellcome_Trust/Data Methods Core/Data/BEC Data/BEC_L2_08162023.csv") |> 
  filter(SALID2 %in% unique(df_mort$SALID2)) |> 
  mutate(SALID1 = as.factor(SALID1),
         SALID2 = as.factor(SALID2)) |> 
  select(SALID1, SALID2, BECGSPCTL2)
 
# # ISSUE: MISSING SALID2 IN MORTALITY DATA
# SALID2_mort <- unique(df_mort$SALID2);   length(SALID2_mort)
# SALID2_BEC  <- unique(df_BEC_L2$SALID2); length(SALID2_BEC)
# 
# # IDs 20610111 and 20610133 are missing
# L2_missing <- SALID2_BEC[-map_dbl(SALID2_mort, \(x) str_which(SALID2_BEC, x))]
# 
# df_BEC_L2 <- filter(df_BEC_L2, !(SALID2 %in% L2_missing))

# SEC
df_SEC_L2 <- vroom::vroom("//files.drexel.edu/colleges/SOPH/Shared/UHC/Projects/Wellcome_Trust/Data Methods Core/Data/SEC Data/SEC_Census_L2_07062023.csv") |> 
  filter(SALID2 %in% unique(df_mort$SALID2)) |> 
  mutate(SALID1 = as.factor(SALID1), 
         SALID2 = as.factor(SALID2)) |> 
  summarise(CNSMINPR_L2 = mean(CNSMINPR_L2), .by = c(SALID1, SALID2))

# Neighborhood level modifier data
# Needed for age variable
df_nbhd <- vroom::vroom("data/dat_all_2023-08-01.csv") |> 
  filter(SALID2 %in% unique(df_mort$SALID2)) |> 
  mutate(SALID1 = as.factor(SALID1),
         SALID2 = as.factor(SALID2))

# Age data
age_categories <- str_subset(names(df_nbhd), "CNSAGE")
under_65 <- age_categories[1:13]
over_65  <- age_categories[14:21]

# Specify percentage of population over 65 for each L2 neiborhood
df_age <- df_nbhd |> 
  mutate(n_under_65 = rowSums(pick(all_of(under_65)), na.rm = TRUE),
         n_over_65  = rowSums(pick(all_of(over_65)),  na.rm = TRUE),
         n_total = n_under_65 + n_over_65) |> 
  #filter(n_total != 0) |> 
  summarize(n_over_65 = sum(n_over_65),
            n_total = sum(n_total), .by = SALID2) |> 
  mutate(percent_over_65 = n_over_65/n_total, .keep = "unused")


# Aggregate final data frame
df <- df_mort |> 
  #left_join(df_pop, by = c("SALID1", "YEAR")) |> 
  left_join(df_temp, by = c("SALID1", "YEAR", "MONTH", "DAY")) |> 
  left_join(df_BEC_L2, by = c("SALID1", "SALID2")) |> 
  left_join(df_SEC_L2, by = c("SALID1", "SALID2")) |> 
  left_join(df_age,    by = "SALID2") |> 
  filter(!if_any(c(TMP_PW, percent_over_65, BECGSPCTL2, CNSMINPR_L2), is.na)) |> 
  arrange(SALID2, YEAR, MONTH, DAY)

write_csv(df, "data/mort_temp_with_L2_modifiers.csv")
```

# Analysis

First we read in our constructed data frame, correct the variable types, and add our `strata` variable. Here `strata` only includes year, month, and day of the week; however, in our pooled analysis it will also include the L2 IDs.

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| code-summary: "Code to read in data frame."

# Data frame for city-specific analysis
df <- vroom::vroom("data/mort_temp_with_L2_modifiers.csv") |> 
  mutate(across(c(ISO2, SALID1, SALID2), as.factor),
         date = ymd(paste(YEAR, MONTH, DAY, sep = "-")),
         strata = paste(YEAR, MONTH, lubridate::wday(date, label = TRUE), sep = ":") |> as.factor())

glimpse(df)
```
We perform two kinds of analysis in this document:

1. **City Specific:** In this analysis, we reduce the rows to the L1:year:month:day level and perform analysis separately for each city at the L1 level. We report a simple temperature mortality curve for each L1.  
1. **City with Modifier:** In this analysis, we keep the rows at the L2:year:month:day level. For each L1, we pool the results of its respective L2s using modifiers at the L2 level. We report these results giving a temperature mortality curve for a high value of the modifier (90th percentile) and low value (10th percentile) for each L1.

All curves are centered at their curve specific MMT.

## Curves by City

```{r}
#| code-summary: "City level analysis"

# Data frame for city-specific analysis
df_city <- df |> 
  summarize(DEATHS = sum(DEATHS),
            across(c(L1NAME,# POP,
                     TMP_PW, strata), first), .by = c(SALID1, YEAR, MONTH, DAY))

city_IDs <- unique(as.character(df_city$SALID1))
city_names <- unique(as.character(df_city$L1NAME))

# Model
plot_by_city <-
  map2(city_IDs, city_names, \(ID, name_l1) {
    # Case TS
    # df0 <- df |>
    #   filter(SALID1 == ID, !is.na(TMP_PW), DEATHS>0) |>
    #   mutate(SALID2 = as.factor(as.character(SALID2)),
    #          strata = as.factor(paste(SALID2, strata, sep = ":")))
    
    # Aggregated TS
    df0 <- df_city |>
      filter(SALID1 == ID, !is.na(TMP_PW), DEATHS>0)
    
    # Specify knots placement
    var_knots <- quantile(df0$TMP_PW, c(.1, .75, .9), na.rm = TRUE)
    lag_knots <- logknots(21, nk = 5)
    
    # Specify cross-basis
    cbt <- crossbasis(df0$TMP_PW, lag = 21,
                      argvar = list(fun = "ns", knots = var_knots),
                      arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = lag_knots), # group = df0$SALID2
                      )
    
    # Fit city-specific model
    model <- gnm(DEATHS ~ cbt,
                 family = quasipoisson(),
                 #offset = log(POP),
                 eliminate = strata,
                 data = df0)
    
    # Get exposure response curve/surface by city
    pred <- crossreduce(cbt, model, cen = median(df0$TMP_PW))
    pred <- crossreduce(cbt, model, cen = get_cen(pred))
    
    # Data frame for plotting RRs
    df_plot <- get_df_RRs(pred)
    
    # Plot curve and histogram of observed temperatures by city
    p_curve <- df_plot |>
      ggplot(aes(x = Temperature)) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = RR_low, ymax = RR_high), alpha = .2) +
      geom_line(aes(y = RR), color = "red") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 1) +
      scale_y_continuous(transform = "log", labels = \(x) round(x, 2)) + # c(0.85, 1.8)
      labs(title = glue("{name_l1}"))

    p_hist <- df0 |>
      ggplot(aes(TMP_PW)) +
      geom_histogram(alpha = .2, bins = 35) +
      labs(title = "Observed Temperatures",
           x = "Temperature",
           y = "Count (in 1000s)") +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) {x/1000})

    p_curve / p_hist
  })

```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 8
#| code-summary: "Plot of of city-level exposure-response curves."

wrap_plots(plot_by_city)

```

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Analysis by city and neighborhood level modifier."

analysis_with_interaction <- function(variable) {
  map2(city_IDs, city_names, \(ID, name_l1) {
    # Case TS
    df0 <- df |>
      filter(SALID1 == ID, !is.na(TMP_PW), DEATHS>0) |>
      mutate(SALID2 = as.factor(as.character(SALID2)),
             strata = as.factor(paste(SALID2, strata, sep = ":")))
    
    # Specify knots placement
    var_knots <- quantile(df0$TMP_PW, c(.1, .75, .9), na.rm = TRUE)
    lag_knots <- logknots(21, nk = 5)
    
    # Specify cross-basis
    cbt <- crossbasis(df0$TMP_PW, lag = 21,
                      argvar = list(fun = "ns", knots = var_knots),
                      arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = lag_knots),
                      group = df0$SALID2)
    
    # Fit city-specific model
    model <- gnm(DEATHS ~ cbt,
                 family = quasipoisson(),
                 #offset = log(POP),
                 eliminate = strata,
                 data = df0)
    
    #print("BASE MODEL DONE")
    
    # Interaction CBs
    intval <- quantile(df0[[variable]], c(.1, .9))
    cb_int1 <- cbt * (df0[[variable]] - intval[1])
    cb_int2 <- cbt * (df0[[variable]] - intval[2])
    
    # Fit interaction models
    model_int1 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_int1)
    model_int2 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_int2)
    
    #print("INTERACTION MODELS DONE")
    
    # ANOVA
    #anova(model, model_int1, test = "F")
    
    # Predications
    pred_int1 <- crossreduce(cbt, model_int1, cen = median(df0$TMP_PW))
    pred_int1 <- crossreduce(cbt, model_int1, cen = get_cen(pred_int1))
    
    pred_int2 <- crossreduce(cbt, model_int2, cen = median(df0$TMP_PW))
    pred_int2 <- crossreduce(cbt, model_int2, cen = get_cen(pred_int2))
    
    #print("PREDICTIONS DONE")
    
    # Data frame for plotting RRs
    if(variable == "percent_over_65") {
      int_name <- "Proportion 65+"
    } else if(variable == "BECGSPCTL2") {
      int_name <- "Greenspace"
    } else if(variable == "CNSMINPR_L2") {
      int_name <- "Educational Attainment"
    }
    
    df_plot <- 
      bind_rows(get_df_RRs(pred_int1),
                get_df_RRs(pred_int2), .id = "name") |> 
      mutate(name = case_when(
        name == 1 ~ glue("Low {int_name}"),
        name == 2 ~ glue("High {int_name}")
      ))
    
    #print("DF_PLOT DONE")

    # Plot curve and histogram of observed temperatures by city
    p_curve <- df_plot |>
      ggplot(aes(x = Temperature)) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = RR_low, ymax = RR_high, fill = name), alpha = .2) +
      geom_line(aes(y = RR, color = name)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 1) +
      scale_y_continuous(transform = "log", labels = \(x) round(x, 2)) + # c(0.85, 1.8)
      scale_color_viridis_d() +
      scale_fill_viridis_d() +
      labs(title = glue("{name_l1}"),
           fill = "", color = "") +
      theme(legend.position = "top") 

    p_hist <- df0 |>
      ggplot(aes(TMP_PW)) +
      geom_histogram(alpha = .2, bins = 35) +
      labs(subtitle = "Observed Temperatures",
           x = "Temperature",
           y = "Count (in 1000s)") +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) {x/1000})

    p_curve / p_hist
    
  })
}

```
